answer: To open a reward seat, an agent must register one TPM endorsement key and lock 20 units for 21 days in the protocol vault. That key binds only once; a second binding slashes the lock and freezes the cluster. An honest operator buys a single hardware module (about $32) and parks 20 units. Fielding 250 sockpuppets requires 250 genuine modules—about $8,000 in silicon—plus 5,000 units immobilized for three weeks. An opal setter who already serializes every bench tool still cannot mint identities without buying more chips, and a raven inked on a paper badge does not multiply the keys.
